major_cooldowns.name: Trueshot
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it only while Double Tap is down, entering it off the back of a Rapid Fire and immediately before an Aimed Shot, and hold the last one of the fight until Bullseye is at 30 stacks below 20% target health.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown 120s; the guide states 90s with Calling the Shots and 120s with Unerring Vision. Duration 15s, 19s as Sentinel.

major_cooldowns.name: Volley
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it whenever Double Tap is down, and never adjacent to Trueshot: fit an Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire between the two so the Double Tap it grants is not wasted.

major_cooldowns.name: Explosive Shot
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Low-priority filler when nothing else is available; with Shrapnel Shot fire it outside Trueshot while Lock and Load is down and Aimed Shot is at one charge or less.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it about 4.5 seconds before the pull, then use it with Trueshot, firing it when Trueshot is within 5 seconds of coming up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket, only present when the player carries it.

rule.description: Arcane Shot or Black Arrow spends Precise Shots
rule.action: Follow every Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire with a Precise Shots spender: Arcane Shot or Black Arrow on single target, Multi-Shot on three or more. Precise Shots does not stack, and spending it fuels Spotter's Mark.

rule.description: Arcane Shot only with Precise Shots up
rule.action: Cast Arcane Shot only with Precise Shots active: it hits 50% harder and costs 60% less Focus. The one accepted exception is a first Multi-Shot pressed purely to turn on Trick Shots.

rule.description: Bulletstorm kept up for Aimed Shot
rule.action: Keep Bulletstorm rolling with Rapid Fire and avoid Aimed Shot without it. Do not refresh with Rapid Fire when that would replace more stacks than it builds; a Double Tap Rapid Fire yields 18 stacks instead of 10.

rule.description: Trueshot entered off the back of Rapid Fire
rule.action: Fire Rapid Fire immediately before Trueshot so the window opens on full Bulletstorm stacks, then press Trueshot right ahead of an Aimed Shot. On single target, spend Volley's Double Tap on that Rapid Fire for 18 stacks.

rule.description: Open Aimed Shot, Volley, Rapid Fire, Trueshot
rule.action: Pre-cast Aimed Shot 2.5 seconds before the pull with Hunter's Mark already up, then Black Arrow and a second Aimed Shot, Volley for Double Tap, Rapid Fire to spend it for 18 Bulletstorm stacks, then Trueshot with potion and racials.

rule.description: Multi-Shot replaces Arcane Shot on AoE
rule.action: From three targets, spend Precise Shots with Multi-Shot instead of Arcane Shot: it needs three hits to grant Trick Shots, which every Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire wants up.
